# PCCX — Parallel Compute Core eXecutor

PCCX is an open-source semiconductor project initiated and operated by
Altifigence. It develops public RTL, verification assets and technical
documentation. Its current participation focus is SystemVerilog RTL
and verification developers.

Canonical documentation: https://docs.pccx.ai/
English: https://docs.pccx.ai/en/
한국어: https://docs.pccx.ai/ko/

## Start and contribute

- [Quickstart](https://docs.pccx.ai/en/docs/quickstart.html)

- [Contribution roadmap](https://docs.pccx.ai/en/docs/roadmap.html)
- [Evidence requirements](https://docs.pccx.ai/en/docs/Evidence/index.html)

## Development setup

The v002 simulation runner uses Vivado xsim and currently depends on an
external trace converter. Work to simplify the setup is tracked in KV260 #152.
The Getting started guide describes the current environment and the
repository checks available to new contributors.
